**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

The branch of physics concerned with the properties of sound
solution:
The correct answer is **"Acoustics."****

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **"Acoustics"** is the branch of physics that deals with the study of sound, its transmission, production, and effects. (भौतिकी की वह शाखा जो ध्वनि, उसके संचरण, उत्पादन और प्रभावों के अध्ययन से संबंधित है)
 
• It involves the behavior of sound waves in various environments and their interaction with materials, surfaces, and obstacles.
 
• Acoustics is concerned with understanding how sound is produced, propagated, and received, as well as how it interacts with different mediums.
 
• The correct answer is option 4.
